card.name: Release after extended in drug names
card.fires_on: The word release (usually as -release) right after extended in a drug product name, such as extended-release tablets or capsules. It appears in dosing and warning sections.

modes.label: Lowercase hyphenated
modes.description: The -release piece follows lowercase 'extended' in a drug name before tablets or capsules.

modes.description: The capitalized Release follows 'Extended-' in a title-case product name.
